areaGuide.title: Living in Kepong – Complete Guide to Room Rental, Condo & Apartment Rental in Kuala Lumpur
areaGuide.description: Kepong is one of the most popular and rapidly developing residential areas in northern Kuala Lumpur, offering a wide range of room rental, condominium rental and apartment rental options for students, working professionals, families and expatriates. Located approximately 10 kilometres from Kuala Lumpur City Centre, Kepong provides an attractive balance between affordable rental prices, excellent transportation connectivity, modern residential developments, shopping facilities and nature-focused lifestyle living. Whether you are searching for a master room for rent in Kepong, single room rental near MRT Kepong Baru, fully furnished condo room, studio apartment, affordable apartment rental or premium condominium residence, Kepong offers diverse accommodation choices suitable for different budgets and lifestyles. The area is especially popular among professionals working in Mont Kiara, Sri Hartamas, KL Sentral, Petaling Jaya and central Kuala Lumpur due to its strategic location and accessibility. Residents enjoy convenient access through MRT Putrajaya Line stations including Kepong Baru MRT Station, Metro Prima MRT Station and Jinjang MRT Station, as well as KTM Kepong Station and Kepong Sentral KTM Station. Major roads including Jalan Kepong, MRR2, DUKE Highway and LDP provide excellent connectivity to Kuala Lumpur and surrounding areas. Popular landmarks such as AEON Mall Metro Prima, Brem Mall, Desa ParkCity, Kepong Metropolitan Park, FRIM (Forest Research Institute Malaysia), Perdana Botanical Gardens and major healthcare facilities make Kepong one of the most attractive rental locations in Kuala Lumpur. With its combination of affordable housing, public transport access, greenery, shopping convenience and proximity to premium neighbourhoods, Kepong continues to experience strong demand in the Kuala Lumpur rental market.
